title: Watt Enchants
description: This small mod adds 3 new movement based enchants for minecraft.
body:
Bash - an enchant for the shovel, this gives the shovel essetially directional knockback 1 except it also applies your momentum.

Rebound - an enchant for the axe that makes you bounce off victims, works well up close and looking down.

Stall - an enchant for the hoe that will pause any victims momentum by completely stopping it while sprinting.
